object.attr: derived: MELLON-MCP-SRS-11 serves such a clone, which is also what a server started in the wrong folder sees, and MELLON-MCP-SRS-12's warning reaches only the client's log (CF-M7).
object.description: If the folder to serve holds no document when the MCP server starts, the MCP server shall state in the instructions that the repository holds no document.
